composite_controller_specific_configs._comment_vla: VLA deploy: the SONIC whole-body DECODER (mode_id=0, same as sonic_planner) is fed an externally-supplied 64-D motion token via composite_controller.set_vla_action() instead of running the encoder. Finger joints are PD-driven to the policy's predicted left/right hand joints. No PICO, no kPlanner -- the GR00T policy provides the token directly.
composite_controller_specific_configs._comment_paths: ckpt paths resolved by resolve_ckpt_path() -- absolute paths used as-is, otherwise relative to the SIM2REAL repo root ($SIM2REAL_ROOT, else the installed sim2real package). Checkpoints are never kept in this repo. Only the decoder is used at runtime; the encoder is loaded but never run.
